Frequently Asked Questions

What does UNIRAB's plans include?

We make businesses visible to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. When people ask AI for recommendations, we ensure your clients' businesses appear in the results. Every plan includes indexing across all major AI platforms, optimization, and ongoing updates as AI evolves.

How do clients track results?

UNIRAB does not provide separate reporting - clients can track AI referral results directly in their existing analytics (Google Analytics, etc). They'll see traffic from ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI platforms just like they see Google or social media traffic.

What results can I promise clients?

Results will vary depending on the client's business and service area, but most businesses can expect to start seeing AI referral customers within 30 days. AI-referred visitors convert at nearly 2x the rate of Google Search traffic.

What limitations should I be aware of?

Unlike Google rankings (where #1 is #1 for everyone), AI responses vary by user, query, and context. Your client won't appear in every AI recommendation, even for similar questions.

If they test by asking ChatGPT about their business, they might not see themselves recommended. This is normal. AI platforms personalize responses based on many factors we can't control.

We recommend setting expectations accordingly: we maximize their chances of being recommended, but can't promise specific placements or responses.

Which businesses does UNIRAB support?

We work with virtually all business types - local services, consultants, coaches, eCommerce, and more. The only exceptions are restricted categories that AI platforms limit: politics, religion, pharmaceuticals, adult content, and self-harm related topics.

Can I test the service first?

Absolutely! We encourage all partners to test our service first. You can use your Reseller Code to try the service yourself.

How quickly can I start selling?

As soon as your application's approved, you can start offering UNIRAB to your clients immediately. Many partners sign their first client within 5 days.

Do I handle technical support?

We handle all technical optimization and implementation. You focus on the client relationship and billing. If clients have technical questions, you can escalate to us behind the scenes.
